title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: rejection at registration for a loss the tier does not pay
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line fixes when a registered notice is rejected at registration with the reason not covered by tier, including the reefer service test for temperature damage.

## Rule

1. A kind of loss that is not among the product's covered kinds of loss gives the reason not covered by tier.
2. Temperature damage on a container whose reefer service tier rank, in the reefer charter, is below the product's lowest rank for temperature damage also gives the reason not covered by tier.
3. The reefer service is the one recorded for the cover holder on the cover's booking for the container named on the notice. A container with no reefer service counts as tier rank 0.

## Reefer service tier ranks

| Reefer service | Tier rank |
|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 1 |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 2 |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 3 |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 4 |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 5 |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 6 |
| No reefer service on the container | 0 |

## Truth table

| Kind of loss among the product's covered kinds | Temperature damage | Reefer rank at least the product's lowest rank | This ground applies |
|---|---|---|---|
| No | either | not tested | Yes |
| Yes | No | not tested | No |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Yes | Yes | No | Yes |

## Hypothetical cases (hypothetical lowest rank of 3)

- Temperature damage in a container on AHL Reefer Monitored: rank 2 is below 3, so the ground applies.
- Temperature damage in a container on AHL Reefer Cold Treatment: rank 3 is not below 3, so the ground does not apply on this test.
- Temperature damage in a dry container with no reefer service: rank 0, below any lowest rank of 1 or more, so the ground applies.
